dedupe_keys.name: flood induced material failure in anchored aboveground atmospheric storage tanks

description: Flood induced material failure in anchored aboveground atmospheric storage tanks is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Sabarethinam Kameshwar, Louisiana State University (lsu.edu). Material failures (yielding and rupture) in shell and bottom plates in anchored above ground storage tanks’ (ASTs) during flood events were investigated. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-3jg0-1p09. Keywords: Above ground storage tanks; buckling; bottom plate; rupture; yielding; simulation; LS-Dyna. Published 2023-12-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
